scenes.text: Three ingredients cost a fortune. Can you guess them?
First, caviar. The rarest comes from an albino sturgeon and can cost tens of thousands of dollars a kilo.
Second, vanilla. Every orchid flower opens for just one day, so farmers pollinate each one by hand.
Third, edible bird's nest, made from the dried saliva of swiftlets.
Which one would you try first?
Follow for the next luxury secret.
